description: Election Commission Notice Under Section 66A (1) (a) Filling of a Vacancy in the office of member of the Polonnaruwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Polonnaruwa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes - declaring a candidate elected to fill a vacant seat in a local authority following a resignation, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
